description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_Extension_DeliveryLog_RawBucketProcessingStrategyMysqli, which implements a strategy for processing and pruning raw data buckets in a distributed MySQL environment for the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for processing data buckets, pruning data, and retrieving bucket content, specifically tailored for handling raw, non-aggregated delivery log data.

classes.name: OX_Extension_DeliveryLog_RawBucketProcessingStrategyMysqli
classes.description: A class implementing a processing strategy for raw delivery log data buckets in MySQL, including methods for processing, pruning, and retrieving bucket data.

methods.name: processBucket
methods.description: Processes a raw data bucket up to a specified end date, inserting data into the database in optimized chunks.

methods.name: pruneBucket
methods.description: Prunes (deletes) data from a bucket up to a specified end date, optionally within a start date range.

methods.name: getBucketTableContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a bucket table as a recordset up to a specified end date.
